system.descricao:
Kuchiyose: Rashoumon
Source: Hijutsu Vol. 2, PDF pp. 141–143

Prerequisite: Spirit or Intelligence 8.
Type: Ninjutsu / Summoning; common aptitude (does not follow the Kuchiyose power rules).
Action: Movement.
Range: 5 m + 1 m per Spirit or Intelligence level.
Area: Wall width and height each 0.5 m per Spirit or Intelligence level.
Hardness: Spirit or Intelligence level.
Duration: Continuous; gates remain until destroyed or scene end.
Chakra cost: Half the Spirit or Intelligence score used to define the technique.

Summons a defensive wall between user and attacker; cannot block adjacent attacks because it requires space. Defense requires a Magic Level test with +2 accuracy; pay chakra before rolling. Damage beyond the wall hardness passes through when the gate is destroyed. Only one gate at a time at base level. Opening or closing the gate is a free action, but only once per round.

Level 2: Requires Spirit or Intelligence 12. +2 Hardness, up to 3 gates; summon all in one movement action. If summoning multiple gates, divide total Hardness among them. One gate can be summoned with a partial action.

Level 3: See PDF p. 143 for complete advancement; may summon up to 5 gates, dividing total Hardness among them.

       CHAPTER IV - COMMON OPTIONS

            KUCHIYOSE: RASHOUMON

                      Common Aptitude





The southern gates of the ancient Japanese capital from the Nara period, and one
of the ancient cities that would give rise to what we know today as Kyoto, are a
powerful defensive invocation that appears as a large wall with the face of an oni,
supposedly impenetrable.

ÿ Prerequisite: Spirit or Intelligence 8
ÿ Ninjutsu / Summoning

PDF page 142:
ÿ Action: Movement
ÿ Range: 5 + 1m per Spirit or Intelligence Level
ÿ Area of Effect: Wall with a width and height equal to ½ m per Level of
     Spirit or Intelligence
ÿ Toughness: Level of Spirit or Intelligence
ÿ Duration: Continuous
ÿ Chakra Cost: ½ Spirit or Intelligence (whichever is used to define the
    technique's parameters)

This ability does not follow the rules of the Kuchiyose power.

You summon the great Rashoumon gates in the form of a large wall to block
enemy attacks.

There needs to be space between you and the enemy for the gates to be
summoned (therefore, it's not possible to use the barrier to defend against an
attack from an adjacent enemy).

Using Kuchiyose: Rashoumon as a defense requires a Magic Level test with +2
accuracy and a chakra cost paid before the test.

When destroyed, those protected by the barrier will suffer the difference in
damage after the reduction for its hardness.

As long as they are not destroyed, the Rashoumon Gates remain on the
battlefield, only disappearing at the end of the scene (ideally at the end of the
combat). You cannot have more than one Rashoumon Gate summoned at the
same time, however you can summon a new one whenever you dispel the first
one or it is destroyed.
Because they are gates, the user can cause the oni's face to open, allowing
people or techniques to pass through without difficulty. Doing so is a free action,
however, it is only possible to open and close the gates once in the same round
(for example, opening at the beginning of the turn, attacking, and closing before
the end of the turn).

Level 2: When you reach Spirit or Intelligence 12, you can repurchase this
aptitude to evolve it. Your Rashoumon gates gain +2 Hardness. You can have up
to 3 gates summoned at the same time instead of just 1. It is possible to summon
all 3 gates simultaneously using the same movement action, creating a triangle
formation that can only be escaped from above. However, when doing so, the
total Hardness of each gate is divided by the number of gates summoned (for
example, if you summon 3 gates and the total Hardness is 15, each gate would
have 5 Hardness).


All those who can be imprisoned have the right to make a defense against their
DC roll. Summoning only 1 gate can now be done with a partial action instead of
a move action.

Level 3: When you reach Spirit or Intelligence 18, you can purchase this skill
again to evolve it further. Your Rashoumon Gates gain +3 Hardness (not
stackable with the Level version).
2) You can have up to 5 gates summoned at the same time. Your gates will no
longer receive damage to their hardness. If damage is not enough to destroy the
gate, all damage is ignored and the hardness remains. It is possible to use a
move action to summon up to 5 gates at the same time.
